text_block_list.text:
This is the start of Seiun Sky's second
summer
camp.

Having arrived early to help out the
academy
staff, I head over to meet her
at the bus stop.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
For goodness' sake, Sky! Wake up this
instant!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
King... Just carry me to the campsite,
pleeease.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Absolutely not! Now stand up straight!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's nothing. More importantly, is she
all
right?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
She was like this all the way here. There
isn't a
speck of motivation to be found in
her.

It's true that Sky can be sluggish, but
working
hard while pretending she has
no drive is her
whole deal.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Well, I'm pleased to hear that, but—
choice_data_list: She gets serious once training starts.

text_block_list.text:
With a vague sense of unease, summer
camp
begins...
